text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I am not some ordinary princess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"There she is! The savage Umamusume!
She thinks
she's a princess?! She's just a
savage!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Look here. The princess in this book is
gentle
and calm. If you want to become
a princess, you
need to be quiet and
well-behaved."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm not the princess that you all imagine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"You aren't fit to enter a dignified and
historic
race like the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup. You never
were."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Everything you say, everything you do,
it's
always about yourself. You're the
worst princess
there is."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Some people may see me that way. But
even still,
I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But you stayed true to your ideal of a
princess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But you stayed true to your ideal of a
princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am me! And I'm proud of who I am! I'm
going to
become my ideal princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That was super cool. I so felt your passion while we were runnin'.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Can I... challenge you again sometime?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, of course! I look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, phew... My heart's pounding like
crazy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's been one heated battle after
another. Could
it already be time for the
final episode?! Who will
the princess
challenge next?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: There can only be one race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So then, Kawakami Princess! You've got
your
sights set on the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup next!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Have you heard all the varied opinions
about
you? Especially in regards to the
Queen Elizabeth
II Cup...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are those who feel that I do
not
conduct myself as a queen should.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
However, I don't believe that's a
problem.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I, Kawakami Princess, will enter the
Queen
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I have high expectations of the other
princesses
I'll meet there—the
Umamusume who strive to be
queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To all those who, like me, pursue their
ideal
selves, I say this! Let's battle in the
Queen
Elizabeth II Cup!
